title: ops.matrix_diag_part rejects documented int k on CPU
duplicate_search_result: No exact matching GitHub or Gitee issue found.
documentation_notes: MindSpore 2.9 official ops.matrix_diag_part documentation lists k as Union[int, Tensor] and lists CPU as a supported platform.
The docs note that k and padding_value must be const tensors when taking graph mode, but the Python-int form is rejected in PyNative mode as well.
classification_notes: Not a numerical precision issue: the call fails before producing a value.
Not a CPU kernel issue: the Tensor-valued k control succeeds in both PyNative and Graph mode.
Scoped to the documented int k argument form.
Additional TMDP confirmation covers both k=0 and a valid nonzero k=1 case while keeping padding_value as Tensor.
